evidence_type: Offline diagnosis of four preserved native runs

rows.evidence_type: Offline independent coordinate diagnosis of an original completed native run

graph_audit.evidence_type: Independent evaluation of recorded native and retained-scan component coordinates
limits: Retained scans omit the original ROS transport, discarded scans and mapper scheduling.
Component output is not a new navigation, recognition or completion result.
Loop event timing plus a controlled no-loop comparison is evidence about this recording only.

limitations: Truth substitution is retrospective diagnosis, not deployable localization or navigation success.
Robot poses are interpolated across at most 0.35s gaps; residuals include timing and interpolation uncertainty.
This audit identifies localization/final-graph contributions, not the underlying cause of every SLAM update.
